hints.content: Pick any segment on the slope field and, using the direction of the segment, draw a particular solution to the differential equation used to create this slope field.
This should give you a shape resembling half of a sideways parabola.  Hence, $\displaystyle~y=\sqrt{x}+C~$ is the requested general solution.
